title: Brew unit fault
shortDescription: Brew group did not return to home position.
fullDescription:
Bosch automatic coffee machines (VeroCup, VeroAroma) show E01 when the brew unit position sensor does not detect home within the timeout. Coffee grounds bound between piston and chamber, or a worn drive gear, are common causes.

Remove the brew unit, clean thoroughly, and lubricate per manual.

causes.cause: Dry or worn brew unit gears

fixSteps.title: Remove and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Take out brew unit, rinse, and lubricate seals.

whenToCallPro: If brew unit drive motor fails.

faq.q: How often should I clean it?
faq.a: Rinse the brew unit weekly with hot water.

title: Empty water tank
shortDescription: Water tank not detected or empty.
fullDescription:
E02 indicates the water tank float is below the minimum or the tank is missing. Recheck seating; mineral residue under the magnet can also cause false readings.

Descale if mineral buildup is suspected.

fixSteps.title: Refill and reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Fill to max and press tank firmly into machine.

faq.a: No, the conductivity sensor needs minerals.

title: Empty drip tray
shortDescription: Drip tray full or not in place.
fullDescription:
E03 indicates the drip tray microswitch is open or the float reports full. Empty and dry the contacts; corrosion can prevent detection.

Check the magnetic float for residue.

title: Grinder jam
fullDescription:
E04 indicates the grinder current draw exceeded limits, suggesting a foreign object or compacted oily beans. Empty the bean hopper, vacuum the burrs, and check for stones.

Use only roasted coffee beans, never flavored or oily varieties.

fixSteps.title: Vacuum burrs
fixSteps.instruction: Remove top burr per manual and vacuum chamber.

title: Boiler temperature fault
fullDescription:
E05 indicates the boiler NTC sensor reading is invalid or the heating element failed open. The machine cannot brew without verified temperature.

This repair typically requires a service technician.

faq.a: Compare to new machine cost; often borderline.

title: Pump pressure fault
shortDescription: Vibration pump cannot reach brew pressure.
fullDescription:
E06 indicates the pump is not building pressure within the expected window. Causes include an air-locked pump, a clogged grind, or a failed pump.

Run the prime cycle from the menu before disassembly.

fixSteps.title: Run prime
fixSteps.instruction: Use Steam/Hot Water to purge air.

faq.a: Yes, scale is a major cause of pressure faults.

title: Steam wand blockage
fullDescription:
E08 indicates the steam circuit pressure exceeded limits, typically from dried milk in the wand. Soak the wand tip in cleaner and clear with the supplied pin.

Run a milk system clean cycle weekly.

fixSteps.title: Clean wand
fixSteps.instruction: Disassemble and soak in milk system cleaner.

faq.a: Yes, run 2 seconds of steam after each milk drink.

title: Cleaning cycle required
fullDescription:
CLN reminds the user to run the automatic cleaning routine. The machine will continue brewing for a limited number of cups before locking out.

Use Bosch cleaning tablets only.

fixSteps.title: Run cleaning
fixSteps.instruction: Insert tablet and follow on-screen prompts.

title: Descaling required
fullDescription:
DESC indicates accumulated water hardness has exceeded the threshold. Failure to descale will damage the boiler.

Use Bosch descaler and follow the on-screen procedure.

fixSteps.title: Descale
fixSteps.instruction: Add descaler to tank and follow prompts (~30 min).

title: System malfunction
fullDescription:
E10 is shown when the controller detects an unrecoverable error not covered by other codes. A power cycle may clear transient issues; persistent E10 requires service.

Document the conditions before calling service.
whenToCallPro: Yes, control board access voids warranty.

faq.a: Often borderline vs new machine cost.
